```{r calibration-helpers, include=FALSE}
plug_in_all_way_prices_dfp <- function(df_p) {
  df_p %>%
    mutate(
      p = dplyr::case_when(
        energy == "elec_coal" ~ 59.4,
        energy == "elec_biomass" ~ 72,
        energy == "Nuclear" ~ 90,
        energy == "elec_other_hydro" ~ 46.8,
        # energy == "gas" ~ 11.3,
        # energy == "oil" ~ 37.3,
        energy == "elec_unabated_gas" ~ 54.9,
        TRUE ~ p
      )
    )
}

compute_total_cost_trillion <- function(df_merged) {
  convert_EJ_to_TWh(df_merged) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    spread(key = variable, value = value) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q, Year) %>%
    summarise(
      cost_trillion_usd = sum(p * q * 10^6, na.rm = TRUE) / 10^12,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

compute_cost_by_energy_billion <- function(df_merged) {
  convert_EJ_to_TWh(df_merged) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    spread(key = variable, value = value) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q, Year, energy) %>%
    summarise(
      cost_bn_usd = sum(p * q * 10^6, na.rm = TRUE) / 10^9,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

build_paper_impact_table <- function(df_plot_energy) {
  c_impacts <- c()
  for (x in unique(df_plot_energy$Scenario_q)) {
    data <- df_plot_energy %>% filter(Scenario_q == x)
    name_x <- unique(data$Scenario_q_name)
    Ahat_energy <- extract_TFP_energy(data)$cum_hat_pp

    if (x == "Fast_Transition") {
      gdp <- GDP_world
      er <- 1
      data <- convert_EJ_to_TWh(data)
    } else {
      gdp <- GDP_UK
      er <- exchange_rate_UK_US
    }

    domar <- compute_domar(df = data, gdp_year = gdp, exch_rate = er)
    c_agg_impacts <- compute_impact_agg_economy(
      df = data,
      GDP = gdp,
      exchange_rate = er,
      Year_TFP = 2050
    )

    c_impacts <- rbind(
      c_impacts,
      c(
        "Scenario" = name_x,
        "Year" = 2050,
        "Domar weight" = round(domar$domar, 3),
        "Energy impact %" = round(Ahat_energy, 2),
        round(c_agg_impacts[c(1, 3)], 3)
      )
    )
  }

  as.data.frame(c_impacts)
}

summarise_tfp_scenario <- function(df,
                                   scenario_label,
                                   geography = c("uk", "world"),
                                   price_source,
                                   grid_cost_usd_mwh,
                                   Year_TFP = 2050) {
  geography <- match.arg(geography)

  if (geography == "world") {
    data_for_agg <- convert_EJ_to_TWh(df)
    gdp <- GDP_world
    er <- 1
  } else {
    data_for_agg <- df
    gdp <- GDP_UK
    er <- exchange_rate_UK_US
  }

  aggregate_impacts <- compute_impact_agg_economy(
    df = data_for_agg,
    GDP = gdp,
    exchange_rate = er,
    Year_TFP = Year_TFP
  )

  tibble(
    Scenario = scenario_label,
    `Price calibration` = price_source,
    `Grid cost (USD/MWh)` = grid_cost_usd_mwh,
    `Domar weight` = compute_domar(data_for_agg, gdp_year = gdp, exch_rate = er)$domar,
    `Energy-sector TFP gain` = extract_TFP_energy(df, Year_TFP = Year_TFP)$cum_hat_pp,
    `Aggregate TFP gain` = as.numeric(aggregate_impacts[["Agg impact %"]])
  )
}

format_tfp_scenario_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      `Grid cost (USD/MWh)` = sprintf("%.0f", `Grid cost (USD/MWh)`),
      `Domar weight` = ifelse(is.na(`Domar weight`), "", sprintf("%.3f", `Domar weight`)),
      `Energy-sector TFP gain` = sprintf("%.0f%%", round(`Energy-sector TFP gain` * 100, 0)),
      `Aggregate TFP gain` = sprintf("%.1f%%", round(`Aggregate TFP gain` * 100, 1))
    )
}

extract_TFP_energy_logbp <- function(df,
                                     Year_TFP = 2050,
                                     quartiles = FALSE,
                                     df_error = df_quantiles_error_extended) {
  df_aihat <- compute_Ahat(df)

  out <- df_aihat %>%
    filter(!is.na(Ahat), Year <= Year_TFP) %>%
    mutate(cum_Ahat = cumsum(Ahat)) %>%
    left_join(df_error %>% mutate(Year = 2022 + horizon), by = "Year") %>%
    mutate(
      q10 = cum_Ahat + q10,
      q25 = cum_Ahat + q25,
      q75 = cum_Ahat + q75,
      q90 = cum_Ahat + q90
    ) %>%
    filter(Year == Year_TFP) %>%
    mutate(
      cum_hat_logbp = cum_Ahat * 10000,
      q10_logbp = q10 * 10000,
      q25_logbp = q25 * 10000,
      q75_logbp = q75 * 10000,
      q90_logbp = q90 * 10000
    )

  if (quartiles) {
    out %>% select(Scenario_q, cum_hat_logbp, q10_logbp, q25_logbp, q75_logbp, q90_logbp)
  } else {
    out %>% select(Scenario_q, cum_hat_logbp)
  }
}
```

```{r build-paper-objects, include=FALSE}
df_p_way_all_way <- plug_in_all_way_prices_dfp(df_p_way)

# UK fast-transition construction

Fast_Way_useful <- Way_useful_energy_raw %>% filter(Scenario_q == "Fast_Transition")

Way_fast_transition_share <-
  Fast_Way_useful %>%
  filter(Year == 2050) %>%
  group_by(Scenario_q, Year) %>%
  mutate(value = q / sum(q))

df_BZN_eleccoal <-
  df_BZN_useful %>%
  filter(energy == "elec_unabated_gas") %>%
  mutate(energy = "elec_coal") %>%
  spread(key = variable, value = value)
df_BZN_eleccoal$q <- 0
df_BZN_eleccoal <-
  df_BZN_eleccoal %>%
  select(-p) %>%
  left_join(
    df_merged_way_useful %>%
      filter(energy == "elec_coal" & variable == "p" & Scenario_q == "Fast_Transition") %>%
      filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
      rename(p = value) %>%
      select(Year, p),
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
  gather(key = variable, value = value, -c("Scenario_q", "Unit", "Year", "energy", "Scenario_p", "ratio_2022", "x_final_useful"))

df_BZN_Way <- rbind(df_BZN_useful, df_BZN_eleccoal)

q_total_final_2050 <-
  df_BZN_Way %>%
  filter(Year == 2050, variable == "q") %>%
  group_by(Scenario_q, Year) %>%
  summarise(total_energy = sum(value), .groups = "drop")

q_initial <-
  df_BZN_Way %>%
  filter(Year < 2026, variable == "q") %>%
  mutate(Scenario_q = "Fast_Transition_UK") %>%
  select(Scenario_q, energy, Year, value)

q_final <-
  Way_fast_transition_share %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Scenario_q = "Fast_Transition_UK") %>%
  mutate(value = value * q_total_final_2050$total_energy) %>%
  select(Scenario_q, energy, Year, value) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))

q_fast_way <-
  q_initial %>%
  spread(key = Year, value = value) %>%
  left_join(q_final %>% spread(key = Year, value = value), by = c("Scenario_q", "energy")) %>%
  gather(key = Year, value = value, -c("Scenario_q", "energy")) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value), 0, value)) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))

q_fast_way <-
  q_fast_way %>%
  group_by(Scenario_q, energy) %>%
  complete(Year = 2026:2050) %>%
  arrange(energy, Year) %>%
  mutate(
    value = if_else(
      is.na(value),
      approx(Year[!is.na(value)], value[!is.na(value)], xout = Year)$y,
      value
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(q = value) %>%
  mutate(variable = "q") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Scenario_q = ifelse(is.na(Scenario_q), "Fast_Transition_UK", Scenario_q)) %>%
  select(Scenario_q, energy, Year, q, variable)

qw <- Way_useful_energy_raw %>%

ratio_qw_qs <-
  df_BZN_Way %>%
  filter(
    Scenario_q == "Balanced Net Zero Pathway",
    Scenario_p == "Balanced Net Zero Pathway",
    variable == "q",
    Year == 2050,

  spread(key = energy, value = value) %>%
  mutate(wind = wind_offshore) %>%
  mutate(ratio_qw_qs = wind / solar) %>%
  select(ratio_qw_qs)

R <- ratio_qw_qs$ratio_qw_qs
S <- qs$q
W <- qw$q
x <- -(W - R * S) / (S * (1 + R))

q_wind_corrected <- pq_fast_way %>%
  filter(variable == "q") %>%
  select(Year, Scenario_q, energy, value) %>%
  spread(key = energy, value = value) %>%
  mutate(
    wind_offshore = wind_offshore + solar * x,
    solar = solar * (1 - x)
  ) %>%
  gather(key = energy, value = q, -c(Year, Scenario_q)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(q))

  "Scenario_q",

)

build_main_overgeneration_scenarios <- function(overgeneration) {
  df_world_fast <- merge_price_quantity_and_add_network(
    Way_useful_energy_raw,
    df_p_way,
    cost_add = 7,
    match_p_q = TRUE,
    overgeneration = overgeneration
  ) %>%
    mutate(Scenario_p = Scenario_q) %>%
    convert_p_final_to_useful() %>%
    mutate(Unit = "EJ") %>%
    filter(Scenario_q == "Fast_Transition") %>%
    mutate(Scenario_q_name = "Global fast transition") %>%
    select(all_of(c_cols))

  df_uk_fast <- merge_price_quantity_and_add_network(
    q_wind_corrected,
    df_p,
    cost_add = 7,
    match_p_q = FALSE,
    overgeneration = overgeneration
  ) %>%
    convert_p_final_to_useful() %>%
    mutate(Unit = "TWh") %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    mutate(
      Scenario_q = "UK fast transition",
      Scenario_q_name = "UK fast transition"
    ) %>%
    select(all_of(c_cols))

  df_uk_bnz <- merge_price_quantity_and_add_network(
    df_q_BZN,
    df_p,
    cost_add = 7,
    match_p_q = FALSE,
    overgeneration = overgeneration
  ) %>%
    convert_final_to_useful() %>%
    filter(Scenario_q == "Balanced Net Zero Pathway") %>%
    mutate(Scenario_q_name = "CCC Balanced Net Zero Pathway") %>%
    select(all_of(c_cols))

  bind_rows(df_world_fast, df_uk_fast, df_uk_bnz)
}

summarise_main_overgeneration <- function(overgeneration) {
  df_sensitivity <- build_main_overgeneration_scenarios(overgeneration)

  bind_rows(
    summarise_tfp_scenario(
      df_sensitivity %>% filter(Scenario_q == "Fast_Transition"),
      "World Fast Transition",
      geography = "world",
      price_source = "BEIS + Way",
      grid_cost_usd_mwh = 7
    ),
    summarise_tfp_scenario(
      df_sensitivity %>% filter(Scenario_q == "UK fast transition"),
      "UK Fast Transition",
      geography = "uk",
      price_source = "BEIS + Way",
      grid_cost_usd_mwh = 7
    ),
    summarise_tfp_scenario(
      df_sensitivity %>% filter(Scenario_q == "Balanced Net Zero Pathway"),
      "UK Balanced Net Zero Scenario",
      geography = "uk",
      price_source = "BEIS + Way",
      grid_cost_usd_mwh = 7
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      `Wind/solar price multiplier` = overgeneration,
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

```{r appendix-output-assets, include=FALSE}
build_price_mix_table <- function(year_value) {
  df_price_mix %>%
    filter(Year == year_value) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q) %>%
    mutate(
      total_q = sum(q, na.rm = TRUE),
      share_energy = q / total_q
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Year, energy, Scenario_q, share_energy) %>%
    mutate(
      share_energy = paste0(round(share_energy, 4) * 100, "%"),
      share_energy = ifelse(share_energy == "0%", "", share_energy)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario_q, values_from = share_energy) %>%
    left_join(df_prices_fast_transition_final, by = c("Year", "energy")) %>%
    left_join(df_prices_fast_transition_useful, by = c("Year", "energy")) %>%
    rename_energy() %>%
    arrange(price_useful) %>%
    select(-Year) %>%
    rename(
      Energy = energy,
      `UK Balanced Net Zero Pathway` = `Balanced Net Zero Pathway`,
      `Global Fast Transition` = Fast_Transition,
      `Final price (USD/MWh)` = price_final,
      `Useful price (USD/MWh)` = price_useful
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(`UK Balanced Net Zero Pathway`, `Global Fast Transition`), ~ replace_na(.x, "")),
      `Final price (USD/MWh)` = round(`Final price (USD/MWh)`, 1),
      `Useful price (USD/MWh)` = round(`Useful price (USD/MWh)`, 1)
    )
}

format_conversion_value <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "--",
    {
      out <- format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
      out <- sub("0+$", "", out)
      sub("\\.$", "", out)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r breakdown-world-UK, include=FALSE}
  exch_rate = 1
)

uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp <- extract_TFP_energy_logbp(df_way_UK_useful_wind)$cum_hat_logbp
world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp <- extract_TFP_energy_logbp(df_world_useful_fast)$cum_hat_logbp

uk_aggregate_useful_logbp <- uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp * uk_domar_useful$domar
world_aggregate_useful_logbp <- world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp * world_domar_useful$domar
uk_with_world_domar_useful_logbp <- uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp * world_domar_useful$domar

uk_world_useful_aggregate_breakdown <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "UK aggregate impact",
    "World aggregate impact",
    "Aggregate gap",
    "UK impact with world Domar",
    "Gap explained by Domar"
  ),
  log_bp = c(
    uk_aggregate_useful_logbp,
    world_aggregate_useful_logbp,
    world_aggregate_useful_logbp - uk_aggregate_useful_logbp,
    uk_with_world_domar_useful_logbp,
    uk_with_world_domar_useful_logbp - uk_aggregate_useful_logbp
  )
) %>%
  mutate(log_bp = round(log_bp, 1))

# The additive decomposition follows the original notebook:
# 1. wind/solar composition, 2. total useful-energy growth,
# 3. initial average-price gap, 4. residual price-path effect.

world_q_growth_useful <- df_world_useful_fast %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2050), variable == "q") %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(total_q = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(log_growth_q = log(total_q) - log(lag(total_q)))

uk_q_growth_useful <- pq_fast_way %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2050), variable == "q") %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(total_q = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(log_growth_q = log(total_q) - log(lag(total_q)))

world_avg_price_useful <- df_world_useful_fast %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2050)) %>%
  spread(key = variable, value = value) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(avg_p = weighted.mean(p, q, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

uk_avg_price_useful <- pq_fast_way %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2050)) %>%
  spread(key = variable, value = value) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(avg_p = weighted.mean(p, q, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

uk_world_useful_gap_logbp <- world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp - uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp
uk_world_useful_mix_logbp <- extract_TFP_energy_logbp(pq_fast_way)$cum_hat_logbp - uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp
uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp <-
  zeta * (
    (world_q_growth_useful %>% filter(Year == 2050) %>% pull(log_growth_q)) -
      (uk_q_growth_useful %>% filter(Year == 2050) %>% pull(log_growth_q))
  ) * 10000
uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp <-
  (zeta - 1) * (
    log(uk_avg_price_useful %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% pull(avg_p)) -
      log(world_avg_price_useful %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% pull(avg_p))
  ) * 10000
uk_world_useful_residual_logbp <-
  uk_world_useful_gap_logbp -
  uk_world_useful_mix_logbp -
  uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp -
  uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp

uk_world_useful_energy_breakdown <- tibble(
  component = c(
    "Total energy-sector gap",
    "Solar/wind mix",
    "Total useful-energy growth",
    "Initial average-price gap",
    "Residual price-path effect"
  ),
  log_bp = c(
    uk_world_useful_gap_logbp,
    uk_world_useful_mix_logbp,
    uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp,
    uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp,
    uk_world_useful_residual_logbp
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    share_of_gap_pct = 100 * log_bp / uk_world_useful_gap_logbp,
    log_bp = round(log_bp, 1),
    share_of_gap_pct = round(share_of_gap_pct, 1)
  )

mix_world_split_2050 <- pq_fast_way %>%
  filter(Year == 2050, variable == "q", energy %in% c("solar", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore")) %>%
  group_by(energy) %>%
  summarise(q = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share_pct = 100 * q / sum(q))

mix_uk_split_2050 <- df_way_UK_useful_wind %>%
  filter(Year == 2050, variable == "q", energy %in% c("solar", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore")) %>%
  group_by(energy) %>%
  summarise(q = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share_pct = 100 * q / sum(q))

world_q_2022_useful <- world_q_growth_useful %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% pull(total_q)
world_q_2050_useful <- world_q_growth_useful %>% filter(Year == 2050) %>% pull(total_q)
uk_q_2022_useful <- uk_q_growth_useful %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% pull(total_q)
uk_q_2050_useful <- uk_q_growth_useful %>% filter(Year == 2050) %>% pull(total_q)

world_q_growth_pct_useful <- 100 * transform_bp_into_pp(log(world_q_2050_useful) - log(world_q_2022_useful))
uk_q_growth_pct_useful <- 100 * transform_bp_into_pp(log(uk_q_2050_useful) - log(uk_q_2022_useful))

world_p_2022_useful <- world_avg_price_useful %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% pull(avg_p)
world_p_2050_useful <- world_avg_price_useful %>% filter(Year == 2050) %>% pull(avg_p)
uk_p_2022_useful <- uk_avg_price_useful %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% pull(avg_p)
uk_p_2050_useful <- uk_avg_price_useful %>% filter(Year == 2050) %>% pull(avg_p)

world_price_change_pct_useful <- 100 * transform_bp_into_pp(log(world_p_2050_useful) - log(world_p_2022_useful))
uk_price_change_pct_useful <- 100 * transform_bp_into_pp(log(uk_p_2050_useful) - log(uk_p_2022_useful))

uk_world_useful_total_price_logbp <-
  uk_world_useful_gap_logbp - uk_world_useful_mix_logbp - uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp

uk_world_useful_lever_details <- tibble(
  lever = c(
    "Total gap",
    "Solar/wind mix",
    "Total useful-energy growth",
    "Initial average-price gap",
    "Residual price-path effect"
  ),
  where_it_comes_from = c(
    sprintf(
      "World energy TFP = %.1f log bp, UK energy TFP = %.1f log bp.",
      world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp,
      uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp
    ),
    sprintf(
      "Counterfactual UK path with world wind/solar split: solar share in wind+solar = %.1f%%, versus %.1f%% in the UK fast-transition mix.",
      mix_world_split_2050 %>% filter(energy == 'solar') %>% pull(share_pct),
      mix_uk_split_2050 %>% filter(energy == 'solar') %>% pull(share_pct)
    ),
    sprintf(
      "Useful energy grows from %.1f to %.1f EJ in the world (%.1f%%), and from %.1f to %.1f TWh in the UK (%.1f%%).",
      world_q_2022_useful,
      world_q_2050_useful,
      world_q_growth_pct_useful,
      uk_q_2022_useful,
      uk_q_2050_useful,
      uk_q_growth_pct_useful
    ),
    sprintf(
      "At the 2022 average useful-energy price, the world is at %.2f USD/MWh and the UK is at %.2f USD/MWh.",
      world_p_2022_useful,
      uk_p_2022_useful
    ),
    sprintf(
      "Average useful-energy price moves from %.2f to %.2f USD/MWh in the world (%.1f%%) and from %.2f to %.2f USD/MWh in the UK (%.1f%%); this is the remaining price contribution once the 2022 starting-price gap is stripped out.",
      world_p_2022_useful,
      world_p_2050_useful,
      world_price_change_pct_useful,
      uk_p_2022_useful,
      uk_p_2050_useful,
      uk_price_change_pct_useful
    )
  ),
  calculation = c(
    sprintf(
      "%.1f - %.1f = %.1f",
      world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp,
      uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_gap_logbp
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.1f - %.1f = %.1f",
      extract_TFP_energy_logbp(pq_fast_way)$cum_hat_logbp,
      uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_mix_logbp
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.3f x [log(%.1f/%.1f) - log(%.1f/%.1f)] x 10000 = %.1f",
      zeta,
      world_q_2050_useful,
      world_q_2022_useful,
      uk_q_2050_useful,
      uk_q_2022_useful,
      uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp
    ),
    sprintf(
      "(%.3f - 1) x [log(%.2f) - log(%.2f)] x 10000 = %.1f",
      zeta,
      uk_p_2022_useful,
      world_p_2022_useful,
      uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.1f - %.1f = %.1f",
      uk_world_useful_total_price_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_residual_logbp
    )
  ),
  contribution_log_bp = round(
    c(
      uk_world_useful_gap_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_mix_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp,
      uk_world_useful_residual_logbp
    ),
    1
  )
)

final_energy_tfp_scenarios <- extract_TFP_energy(
  convert_useful_to_final(df_plot_energy),
  quartiles = FALSE
)

energy_text_numbers <- list(
  uk_world_useful_gap_logbp = uk_world_useful_gap_logbp,
  uk_world_useful_mix_logbp = uk_world_useful_mix_logbp,
  uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp = uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp,
  uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp = uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp,
  uk_world_useful_residual_logbp = uk_world_useful_residual_logbp,
  world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp = world_energy_tfp_useful_logbp,
  uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp = uk_energy_tfp_useful_logbp,
  world_domar_useful = world_domar_useful$domar,
  uk_domar_useful = uk_domar_useful$domar,
  solar_shift_to_wind_share = x
)

save(
  energy_text_numbers,
  uk_world_useful_aggregate_breakdown,
  uk_world_useful_energy_breakdown,
  uk_world_useful_lever_details,
  final_energy_tfp_scenarios,
  df_total_cost_compare_way,
  df_total_cost_compare_way_no_overgeneration,
  tab_main_overgeneration_sensitivity_raw,
  tab_main_overgeneration_sensitivity,
  file = file.path(dataset_path, "paper_text_energy_numbers.RData")
)
```

## All CCC scenario
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
g_useful_5CCC <- local({
  make_compressed_plotter <- function(height_scale = 0.70) {
    fn <- plot_multiple_scenarios
    original_env <- environment(fn)
    compressed_env <- new.env(parent = original_env)
    canvas_original <- get("canvas", envir = original_env)
    ggsave_original <- get("ggsave", envir = original_env)

    compressed_env$canvas <- function(width, height, units = "in", ...) {
      canvas_original(width, height * height_scale, units = units, ...)
    }

    compressed_env$ggsave <- function(..., height = NULL) {
      args <- list(...)
      if (!is.null(height)) {
        args$height <- height * height_scale
      }
      do.call(ggsave_original, args)
    }

    environment(fn) <- compressed_env
    fn
  }

  make_compressed_plotter(height_scale = 0.70)(
    df_plot_energy = df_plot_CB6,
    scenario_ref_p = "Balanced Net Zero Pathway",
    name_file = "g_useful_5CCC.jpeg",
    subtitle_from_y_axis = TRUE,
    remove_y_axis_titles = TRUE,
    compact_height = TRUE
  )
})
```

## CCC Wind Focus Scenarios

```{r ccc-wind-focus, include=FALSE}
# Build wind-focus variants of each CB6 scenario:
# elec_gas_CCS and elec_biomass_CCS quantities are transferred to wind_offshore.
# No additional storage is added (base case as per paper).

cb6_all_scenarios <- c("Balanced Net Zero Pathway", cb6_other_scenarios)

df_CB6_wind_useful <- NULL
for (scen in cb6_all_scenarios) {
  dfq_raw_wind <- dfq_raw_CB6_all %>%
    filter(Scenario_q == scen) %>%
    mutate(
      wind_offshore = wind_offshore + elec_gas_CCS + elec_biomass_CCS,
      elec_gas_CCS  = 0,
      elec_biomass_CCS = 0
    )
  df_q_wind <- prepare_quantity_data_CCC(dfq_raw_wind)
  df_wind   <- merge_price_quantity_and_add_network(df_q_wind, df_p, cost_add = 7)
  df_CB6_wind_useful <- bind_rows(
    df_CB6_wind_useful,
    convert_final_to_useful(df_wind) %>%
      mutate(Scenario_q = paste0(scen, " Wind"))
  )
}

df_plot_CCC_wind <- df_CB6_wind_useful %>%
  mutate(Scenario_q_name = paste0("CCC ", Scenario_q)) %>%
  select(all_of(c_cols))
```

```{r paper-figure-ccc-wind, echo=FALSE}
plot_multiple_scenarios(
  df_plot_energy   = df_plot_CCC_wind%>%filter(Scenario_q=="Balanced Net Zero Pathway Wind"),
  scenario_ref_p   = "Balanced Net Zero Pathway Wind",
  name_file        = "g_scenario_CCC_Wind.jpeg",
  subtitle_from_y_axis = TRUE,
  remove_y_axis_titles = TRUE,
  compact_height   = TRUE
)

extract_TFP_energy(df_plot_CCC_wind, quartiles = TRUE)
```

We test the impact of these few TWh of electricity generated with expensive technologies: they represent an opportunity cost of up to 13bp in terms of productivity over 28 years for the Balanced Net Zero Pathway (technically even less than 28Y, since they are at 0 in 2022, and are developed starting 2026-2027). 
```{r}
cbind(extract_TFP_energy(df_plot_CCC_wind),
  
extract_TFP_energy(df_plot_energy%>%filter(Scenario_q%in% cb6_scenarios)))%>%
  mutate(gap=cum_hat_pp...2-cum_hat_pp...4)
```

```{r paper-useful-gap-prices}
# Initial price effect:
# (zeta - 1) x [log(p_UK,2022) - log(p_world,2022)] x 10000



print("Average price of energy")
cat("World: ")
world_avg_price_useful
cat("UK: ")
uk_avg_price_useful

print("Impact on TFP")
(zeta - 1) * (log(uk_p_2022_useful) - log(world_p_2022_useful)) * 10000

print("Residual price effect (due to network cost)")
# Residual price-path effect:
# total remaining price contribution minus the 2022 starting-price gap
# uk_world_useful_total_price_logbp
# uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp
uk_world_useful_total_price_logbp - uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp
```
Note that the final prices are not exactly equal, 
it is due to difference in the price of solar and wind due to the price of network
Since the network is less developped in the world than in the UK in 2022, 
it means that the development of new capacities in renewables cost more in network

## Decomposition Table

```{r paper-decomposition-table, echo=FALSE}
format_pct_log <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    paste0(round(100 * (exp(x) - 1)), "% (", sprintf("%.2f", x), ")")
  )
}

tab_energy_decomposition_bp <- compute_ahat_decomposition(df_plot_5energy) %>%
  mutate(
    geography = ifelse(
      Scenario_q %in% c("Fast_Transition", "Slow_Transition", "No_Transition"),
      "World",
      "UK"
    ),
    Scenario = case_when(
      Scenario_q == "Fast_Transition" ~ "Fast transition",
      Scenario_q == "No_Transition" ~ "No transition",
      Scenario_q == "Slow_Transition" ~ "Slow transition",
      Scenario_q == "Balanced Net Zero Pathway" ~ "Balanced Net Zero Pathway",
      Scenario_q == "UK fast transition" ~ "Fast transition",
      TRUE ~ Scenario_q
    ),
    Price = format_pct_log(cum_Ahat_p),
    Output = format_pct_log(cum_Ahat_q),
    Total = format_pct_log(cum_Ahat)
  ) %>%
  select(geography, Scenario, Price, Output, Total)

tab_energy_decomposition_bp <- bind_rows(
  tab_energy_decomposition_bp %>%
    filter(geography == "World") %>%
    mutate(
      Scenario = factor(
        Scenario,
        levels = c("Fast transition", "No transition", "Slow transition")
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(Scenario),
  tab_energy_decomposition_bp %>%
    filter(geography == "UK") %>%
    mutate(
      Scenario = factor(
        Scenario,
        levels = c("Balanced Net Zero Pathway", "Fast transition")
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(Scenario)
) %>%
  mutate(Scenario = as.character(Scenario))

build_decomp_rows <- function(df) {
  escape_latex_percent <- function(x) {
    gsub("%", paste0("\\", "%"), x, fixed = TRUE)
  }

  price <- escape_latex_percent(df$Price)
  output <- escape_latex_percent(df$Output)
  total <- escape_latex_percent(df$Total)

  paste0(df$Scenario, " & ", price, " & ", output, " & ", total, " \\\\")
}

world_rows <- build_decomp_rows(tab_energy_decomposition_bp %>% filter(geography == "World"))
uk_rows <- build_decomp_rows(tab_energy_decomposition_bp %>% filter(geography == "UK"))

latex_decomposition_table <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[t]",
  "\\centering",
  "\\caption{Cumulative productivity growth in the energy sector, 2022--2050 (percent change, with additive log growth in parentheses).}",
  "\\label{tab_main5results_break_down_q_p}",
  "\\begin{tabular*}{\\columnwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}lccc@{}}",
  "\\toprule",
  "Scenario ",
  "& \\shortstack{Price\\\\[-0.2em] $\\sum_t(\\zeta-1)\\hat{p}_t$} ",
  "& \\shortstack{Output\\\\[-0.2em] $\\sum_t\\zeta\\hat{X}_t$} ",
  "& Total \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  "\\multicolumn{4}{@{}l}{\\textit{World}} \\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){1-4}",
  world_rows,
  "\\addlinespace[0.4em]",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){1-4}",
  "\\multicolumn{4}{@{}l}{\\textit{UK}} \\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){1-4}",
  uk_rows,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular*}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

writeLines(
  latex_decomposition_table,
  con = file.path(tables_path, "tab_main5results_break_down_q_p.tex")
)

knitr::kable(
  tab_energy_decomposition_bp %>% select(-geography),
  col.names = c("Scenario", "Price", "Output", "Total"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
)
```
